quest.title: City of Chores
quest.description: Wang'ya from Liyue Harbor seems to be troubled by something...
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x30, Hero's Wit x2, Mora x20000

dialogues.speaker: Cai Le
dialogues.text: Luckily, that Xiao Lantern got stuck on a tree. If it'd flown any higher, we wouldn't be able to reach it...

dialogues.speaker: Wang'ya
dialogues.text: I don't know whether I'm coming or going anymore...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's the matter?

dialogues.speaker: Wang'ya
dialogues.text: No worries, I'm just trying to sort out everything that needs to be taken care of for the Lantern Rite.

dialogues.speaker: Wang'ya
dialogues.text: It's just that... The more I think about it, the more issues come up...

dialogues.speaker: Wang'ya
dialogues.text: Even though my colleagues took parts of the workload upon themselves, it's my turn this year to coordinate the Xiao Lantern delivery. If I don't buck up and prepare everything, I won't make it in time...

response.speaker: Wang'ya
response.text: Right... When I said "Xiao Lantern delivery," I meant more than just sending out the lanterns themselves.

response.speaker: Wang'ya
response.text: Simply put... It's more about playing the role of the Lantern Rite ambassador, passing on well-wishes, and creating the festive atmosphere...

response.speaker: Wang'ya
response.text: Even with most people being off work for the festival, including some store owners and their staff...

response.speaker: Wang'ya
response.text: There are still essential workers who can't just take a break — for example, those in charge of keeping order during the celebration, like the Millelith.

response.speaker: Wang'ya
response.text: The Ministry of Civil Affairs usually sends them gifts to acknowledge their hard work around the Lantern Rite season...

response.speaker: Wang'ya
response.text: I was about to visit the Millelith responsible for keeping our city safe to gift them Xiao Lanterns as a token of gratitude.

response.speaker: Wang'ya
response.text: However... We're a little bit short-staffed and haven't managed to send out the gifts to all the soldiers on our list yet...

response.speaker: Wang'ya
response.text: Could you do me a favor and deliver these gifts?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: How could I not?

response.speaker: Wang'ya
response.text: Really? That's amazing! Thank you so much.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Who are the lucky recipients?

response.speaker: Wang'ya
response.text: Let me see... Which of the Millelith haven't been checked off...

response.speaker: Wang'ya
response.text: Xiangming... Hongyi... and Cai Le.

response.speaker: Wang'ya
response.text: I'll mark their stations for you. I can't thank you enough.

choices.text: How many people do you have to send them out to?

dialogues.speaker: Xiangming
dialogues.text: Hmm? Do you need anything? I'm on duty...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Lantern Rite gift delivery!

dialogues.speaker: Xiangming
dialogues.text: Quiet down a bit, I'm working over here! What do you mean, gift delivery?

dialogues.speaker: Xiangming
dialogues.text: Oh, it's from the Ministry of Civil Affairs? I see...

dialogues.speaker: Xiangming
dialogues.text: Another year, another Lantern Rite. And I'd wanted to head home earlier this year, too...

dialogues.speaker: Xiangming
dialogues.text: But given the current situation, I can't relax just yet... I guess I'll be heading home a few hours late again...

dialogues.speaker: Xiangming
dialogues.text: Thanks for coming all this way. I'll take this. Thanks!

dialogues.speaker: Xiangming
dialogues.text: *sigh* When's that fellow going to leave...

dialogues.speaker: Hongyi
dialogues.text: What's wrong with the well...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Lantern Rite gift delivery!

dialogues.speaker: Hongyi
dialogues.text: Huh, this must be from the Ministry of Civil Affairs. Thank you, I'll take it.

dialogues.speaker: Hongyi
dialogues.text: Still, I need to remain on duty for a while more to ensure that no residents come to draw water from the well.

dialogues.speaker: Hongyi
dialogues.text: *sigh* Who knows what's wrong with it... But either way, it can't be drunk from now...

talks.objective: Give the present to Cai Le

dialogues.speaker: Yi Xian
dialogues.text: *sobs* I—I haven't finished writing my wish...

dialogues.speaker: Yi Zhu
dialogues.text: Be a good girl, Little Xian. That nice uncle from the Millelith went to fetch it for you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Have you seen Cai Le?

dialogues.speaker: Yi Zhu
dialogues.text: Are you looking for that nice Millelith?

dialogues.speaker: Yi Zhu
dialogues.text: Little Xian was writing her wish on a Xiao Lantern when she suddenly lost her grip on it, and the Lantern flew away that way...

dialogues.speaker: Yi Zhu
dialogues.text: That Millelith told us he'd seen it hanging on a tree and went to get it for us.

choices.text: What's so special about that Xiao Lantern?

response.speaker: Yi Zhu
response.text: I told her we could make another one, but she...

response.speaker: Yi Xian
response.text: Uh... No... We can't. My brother worked so hard to make that lantern...

response.speaker: Yi Zhu
response.text: Little Xian, that nice uncle will bring it back to us in no time...

response.speaker: Yi Zhu
response.text: My apologies. If you really need to talk to that Millelith, you can find him over there.

talks.objective: Ask Yi Xian and Yi Zhu about Cai Le's whereabouts

dialogues.speaker: Cai Le
dialogues.text: For Archon's sake... How do I get there? Perhaps I should try something different...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you doing?

dialogues.speaker: Cai Le
dialogues.text: Traveler? Haha, it's nothing. I'm just wondering how to climb up that tree and retrieve that Xiao Lantern.

dialogues.speaker: Cai Le
dialogues.text: It's so hard to fight gravity in full armor... I just slip back down each time...

dialogues.speaker: Cai Le
dialogues.text: Eh... Would you mind lending me a helping hand? Recovering that Xiao Lantern shouldn't be too difficult for you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sure thing.

dialogues.speaker: Cai Le
dialogues.text: Great, many thanks. Let's get it done as quickly as we can so the little girl can finally cheer up.

talks.objective: Climb the tree and take down the Xiao Lantern

dialogues.speaker: Wang'ya
dialogues.text: You're back! How did the gift delivery go?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Everyone's got their present.

dialogues.speaker: Wang'ya
dialogues.text: You're a real life-saver... I wouldn't have made it without you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do they have to stay on duty throughout the whole festival?

dialogues.speaker: Wang'ya
dialogues.text: Well... The Ministry of Civil Affairs will schedule alternating shifts for them...

dialogues.speaker: Wang'ya
dialogues.text: But Liyue is too large. There are too many stations and places that need patrolling.

dialogues.speaker: Wang'ya
dialogues.text: We simply don't have enough recruits. Even though they take turns, some of them will get the shorter end of the stick and work during the Lantern Rite.

dialogues.speaker: Wang'ya
dialogues.text: Besides, considering how grand the Lantern Rite celebrations are each year, some parts of the city require additional resources. No matter how we distribute our people, there's never enough manpower.

choices.text: Sounds like a tall order indeed...

response.speaker: Wang'ya
response.text: Well, that's our job... We'll do what we can to ensure that everyone has a nice Lantern Rite.

response.speaker: Wang'ya
response.text: Which reminds me of other people who might need help around the festival time. It'd be nice if you could lend them a hand.

response.speaker: Wang'ya
response.text: The more people we encourage to participate in the Lantern Rite, the more festive its atmosphere will get.

response.speaker: Wang'ya
response.text: We send Xiao Lanterns because we'd like for everyone to be able to release one and make their own wishes.

response.speaker: Wang'ya
response.text: On a broader scale... we'd like the Lantern Rite to spread far and wide. It'd be great if everyone could experience its atmosphere.

response.speaker: Wang'ya
response.text: Lantern Rite is meant for everyone, after all.

response.speaker: Wang'ya
response.text: Alright, duty calls. I hope you have a great time during the Lantern Rite!

dialogues.speaker: Cai Le
dialogues.text: Did you get the Xiao Lantern?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sure did.

dialogues.speaker: Cai Le
dialogues.text: Let me take a look... Yeah, that's the one. You just made those kids' day. I'll give it back to them.

dialogues.speaker: Cai Le
dialogues.text: I hope they are still waiting where I left them...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the gift...

dialogues.speaker: Cai Le
dialogues.text: This must be from the Ministry of Civil Affairs. Alright, gratefully received. Thanks for the trouble.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Was it also your duty as a member of the Millelith?

dialogues.speaker: Cai Le
dialogues.text: Do you mean retrieving lost Xiao Lanterns? Hahahah, of course.

dialogues.speaker: Cai Le
dialogues.text: Doesn't matter if it's finding Xiao Lanterns, chasing after evil-doers, or defeating monsters...

dialogues.speaker: Cai Le
dialogues.text: The Millelith's duty is to help those in need.

dialogues.speaker: Cai Le
dialogues.text: Thank you once again. I need to hurry up and give it back to those kids.

dialogues.speaker: Cai Le
dialogues.text: And then I still have other tasks to complete...

dialogues.speaker: Yi Xian
dialogues.text: I... *sobs* I haven't finished writing my wish. What if it doesn't come true...

dialogues.speaker: Yi Zhu
dialogues.text: It will. I'm sure it will, but only if you behave like a good girl, Little Xian...

dialogues.speaker: Wang'ya
dialogues.text: That's strange... Cai Xun's gift has been delivered, but Cai Le's hasn't...

dialogues.speaker: Wang'ya
dialogues.text: Eh, someone on the gift delivery duty must've had a slip-up...
